exaip23-hypernative: the proposal (2025-04-01) gives the amount (30,000 EXA), the terms (12 months linear via Sablier) and the recipient wallet 0x52c5…ac3c, but not the stream. Stream LL-10-7157 on Optimism matches those terms (30,000 EXA, 2025-04-30 to 2026-04-30, to that wallet) and its sender is 0x23fd…5019, the treasury the gov.exa.eth Snapshot space registers for Optimism. It is very likely the grant, but a stream's sender is written by whoever creates it, so naming the treasury does not prove the DAO funded it; code refuses rather than guess (docs/RESEARCH.md, R2-H1). EXAIP-21 and EXAIP-28 have the same shape and were left out of the run for that reason.
nation3-ant-vestingwallet: the proposal links the ANT vesting contract and proposes withdrawing 20,000 ANT from it; it states no amount, schedule, start or beneficiary for the wallet, so nothing could be kept. On chain the wallet is a standard OpenZeppelin VestingWallet: 300,000 ANT, linear from 2023-03-10 to 2024-03-09, fully released, owner 0x3362…082b. (v1.1.0 recorded BENEFICIARY_DIFFERS here by reading the contract's own link as its beneficiary; that was wrong and is fixed, R2-H2.)
connext-cgp11-wonderland: the 'Connext Vesting Wallet [Wonderland]' at 0xab47…e03f has functions OpenZeppelin's VestingWallet does not (selectors 16d3bfbb, 1e83409a, …): a custom vesting contract, so code does not read a schedule from it.
gitcoin-akita-legacy: 0xcd18…8888 is the legacy Sablier v1.1 contract (2021), a different protocol from Sablier Lockup and not on the allowlist; read as a wallet it is not standard.
ditto-founder: both DittoETH streams linked from the docs (LD2-1-10 founder, LD2-1-11 investor) were canceled on chain; a canceled stream's schedule no longer applies, so nothing is compared.
fu-team-arbitrum: the docs link the team streams from a table cell that only says 'Sablier' and state no amount, cliff or duration for them (the 20% team share sits under a heading elsewhere); the model returned no fields. Stream LL2 #17890 on Arbitrum is a standard linear stream.
cult-idriss-base: the presets file pairs the IDriss address with the note 'Versting until 2028' and the stream link. A year without a day is not a date code reads, and the line has no recipient word, so nothing is kept. On chain LT3-8453-1980 is a tranched IDRISS stream (1,000,008 IDRISS, 34 tranches, 2025-01-06 to 2028-01-05, cancelable) to that address.
pegaxy-team-polygon: the Team vesting contract 0x8757…52d1 is Pegaxy's own contract with AccessControl roles (supportsInterface, getRoleAdmin, grantRole, …), not an OpenZeppelin VestingWallet, so no schedule is read from it. Its README's schedule table (Team & Advisors: 12-month cliff, 12 months vesting) cannot be checked by code.
